question: As of January 2021, who among the following is the Union Minister for Information and Broadcasting.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prakash Javadekar**__.

__
 
• **As of January 2021, Prakash Javadekar is the Union Minister for Information and Broadcasting__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**

__
 
• As of **January 2022, Anurag Thakur** is the **Union Minister for Information and Broadcasting**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Person Name**
 **Details**
 
 

 **Smriti Irani**
 
 
 
• Smriti Irani is an Indian politician and a former television actress and producer.
 
• She is the Minister of Women and Child Development in the Union Cabinet of India since May 2019.
 
• She is a Member of Parliament in the Lok Sabha, representing Amethi.
 
 
 
 

 **Prakash Javadekar**
 
 
 
• He is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party who previously served as the Minister of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Minister of Information and Broadcasting, and Minister of Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises between 2014 to 2021.
 
 
 
 

 **Babul Supriyo**
 
 
 
• He was elected Member of Parliament from Asansol in the 16th and 17th Lok Sabha and also served as the Minister of State for Environment, Forest, and Climate Change, in the Union Council of Ministers.
 
 
 
 

 **Ravi Shankar Prasad**
 
 
 
• Ravi Shankar Prasad is an Indian politician and lawyer, from the Bharatiya Janata Party.
